params.body:
## Why

On staging the vehicle sheet threw on "Volgende":

```
Missing [$rules/rules()] property/method on: [App\Livewire\VehicleForm].
Livewire\Exceptions\MissingRulesException at HandlesValidation.php:499
```

`saveStep()` builds its rules with `Arr::only(VehicleRequest::rulesFor(...), $this->fieldsForStep($step))`
and then strips `required` (the required fields are only demanded on the final save). When that array
ends up empty, `$this->validate([])` is read by Livewire as "the caller passed no rules, so use the
component's own `$rules`/`rules()`" — and this component has neither. Nothing to validate became an
exception, and the draft was never written.

## When it throws

Two ways the array ends up empty, and both are normal:

1. A step whose fields carry no rules of their own. `fieldsForStep()` returns nothing for `photos`,
   `damage` and `options` (those steps are islands, not wired scalars), so `Arr::only(...)` is `[]`.
2. A field whose whole rule set was `['required']`: after `required` is stripped the entry is `[]`,
   which is an empty rule set inside an otherwise non-empty array.

## What changed

One private helper, `VehicleForm::validateRules()`, used by both call sites:

- drops entries whose rule set became empty after the `required` strip;
- returns without calling `validate()` when nothing is left;
- otherwise validates exactly as before.

`saveStep()` then continues to the draft save, so a step without rules saves instead of throwing.
Which rules apply, and when `required` is enforced, is untouched.

## Other call sites

`grep` over `app/Livewire/` for `validate(` / `validateOnly(` gives two call sites, both in
`VehicleForm`, and both now go through the helper:

- `saveStep()` (line 528) — the reported crash.
- `save()` (line 608) — `Arr::only(rulesFor($data), $this->wiredKeys())`. The same trap: it depends
  on `rulesFor()` returning something for at least one wired key, which is nothing the call site
  guarantees. Not observed in the wild; guarded for the same reason.

No other component in `App\Livewire\*` validates, and none declares `$rules`/`rules()`.

## Checked

- New regression test `test_next_on_a_step_without_rules_saves_the_draft_instead_of_throwing`:
  `saveStep('photos')` saves the draft and raises no error, `gotoStep('damage'|'options', true)`
  reaches the step, and a step that does have rules still refuses a malformed number.
- Mutation-checked: that test errors with `MissingRulesException` on current `origin/main`.
- `php artisan test --filter='VehicleForm|Vehicle|OwnStock|SmokeTest'` — 246 tests, 691 assertions,
  1 skipped, green (MySQL loaded from `database/schema/mysql-schema.sql` plus the post-2026-07-28
  migrations, as CI does).

## Overlap

Branch `ui/warn-before-leaving` is adding per-step required-field validation to the same method, and
PR #287 touched this area. This diff is deliberately the minimal one for the empty-rules trap: it
adds a helper and swaps two `$this->validate($rules)` calls for `$this->validateRules($rules)`, so
per-step validation can land on top without a conflict beyond those two lines.
params.title: Vehicle sheet: Volgende no longer throws on a step without rules
